throughput.gpu_in_use_reason: llama-server exposes no CPU/GPU split over HTTP. Verify from the server startup log ('load_tensors: offloaded N/N layers to GPU') and record the -ngl flag used, in runner.launch_command.
throughput.router_should_use: median_effective_tokens_per_sec — it is wall-clock and therefore sees contention that median_sustained_tokens_per_sec, being generation-time only, is blind to.
throughput.effective_window: minute 10 -- the same window as median_sustained_tokens_per_sec, so the two are comparable to each other.
throughput.whole_run_vs_settled_note: median_whole_run_effective_tokens_per_sec averages the entire run, including the fast early minutes. It is ABOVE the settled rate by however much the model decays. Do not quote it as a sustained figure.
throughput.aggregate_correction: Aggregates re-derived from this file's own run_results by tools/spike/reaggregate.py. The samples are unchanged and were never wrong. What changed: median_effective_tokens_per_sec is now the median of the per-run minute-10 wall rate (sustained_effective_tokens_per_sec), matching the window median_sustained_tokens_per_sec already used. Under schema_version 3 it was the whole-run average, which sits above the settled rate by however much the model decays across the run. The whole-run figure is retained under median_whole_run_effective_tokens_per_sec.
